Macron Criticizes Foreign Interference Amidst French Unrest

French President Emmanuel Macron has stated that criticism of the ongoing unrest in France from foreign leaders is "stupid." He asserted that these foreign leaders are attempting to exploit France's tense social climate. Macron vowed to restore order amidst the unrest.
